Shitet, Apartament 1+1+DEPO, 21 Dhjetori, 140,000 Euro
Karakteristikat e Prones:
– Apartament 1+1+Depo
– 21 Dhjetori
– Rruga Kongresi i Lushnjes
– Pallat ekzistues
– Kati 4
– Bosh
– Siperfaqja 59m²
– Cmimi 140,000 Euro
Shitet Apartament 1+1, me siperfaqe 59m², i cili ndodhet ne katin e 4 te ne nje pallat ekzistues ne Rrugen Kongresi i Lushnjes, mbrapa hotel Mondial, 21 Dhjetori. Apartamenti organizohet ne korridor, sallon ndenje, ambient gatimi, ambient ngrenie, 1 dhome gjumi, tualeti, depo dhe ballkoni.
Eshte totalisht i investuar, i shtruar me parket, instalime elektrike/hidraulike te gjitha te reja, dritare me dopio xham, tualeti i pajisur me te gjitha hidrosanitaret e reja etj.
Disponon certefikate pronesie.
Pallati ndodhet ne nje zone shume te kerkuar ne Tirane dhe ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
description_en: For sale, Apartment 1+1+STORAGE, 21 December, 140,000 Euro Property Features: – Apartment 1+1+Storage – 21 December – Kongressi i Lushnja Street – Existing building – Floor 4 – Empty – Area 59m² – Price 140,000 Euro Apartment 1+1, with an area of 59m², for sale, located on the first floor 4 in an existing building in Lushnja Congress Street, behind Mondial Hotel, 21 December. The apartment is organized in a corridor, living room, kitchen, dining room, 1 bedroom, toilet, storage room and balcony. It is fully invested, laid with parquet, all new electrical/hydraulic installations, double-glazed windows, toilet equipped with all new sanitary ware, etc. It has ownership certificates. The palace is located in a very sought-after area in Tirana and offers all the necessary facilities. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
